title: Members can sign in with an email and password, beside the magic link and Google, and can create, reset and set one

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-11-25 (project thread: Restore password login alongside magic link and Google)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: the owner believed password login used to exist. It never did: git back to the first commit (2026-05-25) is magic link plus Google only (ADR-071, ADR-082, ADR-510), and ADR-959's audit (2026-08-07) only recorded passwords as a later third door. Live auth settings read 2026-11-25 from /auth/v1/settings: email and Google on, confirm email ON (mailer_autoconfirm=false), leaked-password protection ON (OWN-007), passkeys off. SHIPPED: /sign-in offers a magic link or a password (one tap between them, the password form first for a device whose last sign-in was a password) plus Google; /sign-in?step=create (signUp, confirmation email, no account enumeration); /sign-in?step=forgot (reset email, same screen for any address, also sets a first password for magic-link and Google members); /sign-in?step=new-password (fresh session only, signs every other session out); The three are steps of the one /sign-in page, not new routes. Settings > Account offers the password link to the member's own address. Rules: lib/auth/password-policy.ts (length floor, bcrypt 72-byte ceiling, not the email, no composition rules, NIST 800-63B), per-mailbox and per-IP limits that fail open like LIVE-043, closed error vocabulary, and lib/auth/finish-sign-in.ts runs the callback's claims, ledger row, funnel recovery and hint for a password sign-in. OWNER DASHBOARD STEPS (docs/RUNBOOKS.md): Supabase minimum password length to match PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, secure password change on, password-changed notification on. ADR-1979. Follow-ups: admin two-step codes and a captcha are their own rows.

verify.note: Fails while any door (password sign-in, create, reset, set, Settings link) is missing or not wired to its auth call, the per-mailbox limit or the post-sign-in claims.
